quarterly_data.quarter: CoreWeave press release: CoreWeave Prices Upsized $3.7 Billion Convertible Senior (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CoreWeave priced a private offering (Rule 144A) of $3.7 billion aggregate principal amount of 2.875% convertible senior notes due 2033, upsized from the previously announced $3.0 billion; settlement was scheduled for September 22, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions, and the initial purchasers were granted an option to buy up to an additional $500 million. Interest is payable semiannually on April 1 and October 1 beginning April 1, 2027, and the notes mature on April 1, 2033. The initial conversion rate is 10.2194 shares of Class A common stock per $1,000 principal amount, an initial conversion price of approximately $97.85 per share, a premium of approximately 22.50% over the $79.88 last reported sale price on September 17, 2026; conversions settle in cash, shares or a combination at CoreWeave's election. CoreWeave may redeem for cash on or after April 5, 2030 if the stock has been at least 130% of the conversion price for a specified period and other conditions are met. The notes are guaranteed by the subsidiaries that guarantee its existing 9.250% senior notes due 2030, 9.000% and 9.750% senior notes due 2031, 9.625% and 8.500% senior notes due 2032, and 1.75% convertible senior notes due 2031 and 2032.
quarterly_data.figure: $3.7 billion of 2.875% convertible senior notes due 2033 (upsized from $3.0 billion; option for up to an additional $500 million); initial conversion price approximately $97.85 per share (approximately 22.50% premium)

quarterly_data.quarter: CoreWeave press release: CoreWeave Prices Upsized $3.7 Billion Convertible Senior (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Use of proceeds from the convertible notes: CoreWeave estimates net proceeds of approximately $3,644.5 million (or approximately $4,137.0 million if the initial purchasers exercise their option in full), after the initial purchasers' discounts and commissions but before estimated offering expenses. It intends to use approximately $498.8 million of the net proceeds to fund capped call transactions and the remainder for general corporate purposes. The capped calls have an initial cap price of $199.70 per share, a premium of 150% over the $79.88 last reported sale price on September 17, 2026, and are expected generally to reduce potential dilution to Class A common stock upon conversion; there would nevertheless be dilution to the extent the market price exceeds the cap price.
quarterly_data.figure: net proceeds approximately $3,644.5 million (approximately $4,137.0 million if the option is exercised in full); approximately $498.8 million to fund capped calls; cap price $199.70 (150% premium)

quarterly_data.quarter: CoreWeave press release: CoreWeave Becomes the Only Provider to Earn SemiAnalysis' (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CoreWeave announced it has earned SemiAnalysis' Platinum ClusterMAX rating for a third consecutive time; CoreWeave says this makes it the only cloud provider to achieve that highest distinction in all three ClusterMAX evaluations to date. Per the release, the first ClusterMAX rating in early 2025 evaluated roughly two dozen providers with CoreWeave the only Platinum, and ClusterMAX 2.0 later that year covered 84 providers with CoreWeave again the only one at the top. In its latest report SemiAnalysis found CoreWeave's health checks worked as intended, with excellent reliability, and nearly all tests reached expected values out of the box; SemiAnalysis also said it uses CoreWeave's clusters as a reference point for what lower-rated companies should aim for. SemiAnalysis highlighted that the Platinum ranking comes from operational discipline on top of the hardware layer; CoreWeave says this shows up in tools that pinpoint underperforming GPUs, continuous testing of idle nodes, and custom hardware designed to contain problems and recover fast.
quarterly_data.figure: SemiAnalysis Platinum ClusterMAX rating for a third consecutive time; ClusterMAX 2.0 field of 84 providers (roughly two dozen in the first rating, early 2025)

quarterly_data.quarter: CoreWeave press release: Harell Data Selects CoreWeave to Power Its Secure Platform (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Harell Data selected CoreWeave under a multi-year agreement: Harell Data will deploy its platform on CoreWeave Cloud to run training, fine-tuning and inference workloads, training and fine-tuning proprietary biotech datasets as it scales its research platform. With CoreWeave, training runs execute inside the Harell Data platform on NVIDIA A100 and NVIDIA Hopper GPUs and the raw data never leaves it; compute is metered per run, and data owners earn a revenue share on every training job executed against their dataset. The release states no contract value, term length or GPU count.
quarterly_data.figure: multi-year agreement; NVIDIA A100 and NVIDIA Hopper GPUs; no value stated
